hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '(\.env$|wdi5\.db$)' && echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"This file is protected."}' || true; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.cds$' && cds compile "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[CDS] Syntax error: $f"; cds compile "$f" 2>&1 | head -5; }; } 2>/dev/null || true

hooks.prompt:
schema.cds was updated. Do two things:

1) Sync CSV seed files:
   Namespace: sap.fe.cap.travel. Run cds compile index.cds --to json. Read db/data/ files. Compare each CSV header (semicolon separator) against the entity schema. If there is a difference, update only the first (header) row — do not touch data rows. CAP rules: Association->fieldName_ID/code, no managed fields, no to-many, no LargeBinary.

2) Sync i18n files:
   Supported languages: en,de,tr. Language list is also in .claude/i18n-config.json.
   Scan schema.cds for @title: '{i18n>KEY}' patterns and collect all KEY values.
   For each app (if app/*/webapp/i18n/ directory exists) and each language:
   - Check i18n.properties (default) + i18n_<lang>.properties files.
   - Append missing KEYs at the end of the file. Do not touch existing keys.
   - Use a human-readable form of the KEY as the value (camelCase -> spaced words).
   - Example: ProductName = Product Name
